tool_args.rationale: The five pilot rows all have s_grad=1, so they cannot separately identify the gradient-dependent parameters. The designated probe varies s_grad and discriminates the open branch.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Constant s_grad makes vmax and rho unidentifiable and leaves the branch completion ambiguous.
The cheaper branch probe directly supplies the missing gradient leverage.
It does not address the identified ambiguity.
